records.rationale: Listed in the current faculty group with displayed title 'Professor - Transitional' (phased-retirement rank per the brief). The department presents him as current faculty (faculty group, not the emeritus group) and no listing states retirement or no active appointment, so the policy's transitional-appointment condition is met and he counts as regular ECE. The JSON cannot show whether the reduced appointment is active; the profile page (not fetched) is the place to confirm. A retirement statement there, or removal from the faculty group, would change the decision to excluded (retired_working or unresolved).

findings.description: All four brief list URLs downloaded by HTTP POST (form dept=1373 with group faculty, emeritus, joint_appt, res_staff) returned HTTP 200 JSON-in-HTML bodies; response bytes hashed as received. Enumerated 27 faculty, 7 emeritus, 9 joint and 15 research-group entries (58 rows). Profile pages were not fetched; decisions rest on the directory JSON.

Enumeration matches the brief: all 58 brief person_ids correspond to listing rows; no omissions in either direction. The brief contains two person_ids for one person named HJ Siegel (person_e54c1dd7cdec5016b928 and person_6c7c1ab2d0a952da9587); both receive the identical excluded decision, and the duplicate identity should be merged by the collector.

Mahmood Azimi-Sadjadi, 'Professor - Transitional' (phased-retirement rank): counted as regular ECE because the department lists him in the current faculty group and no listing states retirement. Would flip to excluded (retired_working) on an official retirement statement; the JSON does not establish whether the reduced appointment is active beyond the department's current-faculty presentation.

Peter Young, 'Professor - Transitional': counted as regular ECE on the same basis as the other transitional-rank listing (current faculty group, no retirement statement). Would flip to excluded on an official retirement statement.
Displayed title 'Research Professor' (HR title 'Professor'); excluded research_only. Would change to regular only on an official regular or tenure-line ECE appointment statement.
Emeritus and research listings for one person; excluded under either reading; both person_ids decided identically.
